newsitem.title: USA: JPM Co to buy Denron in stock transaction.
newsitem.headline: JPM Co to buy Denron in stock transaction.

text.p: The JPM Co and Denron Inc said on Monday they had signed a letter of intent to merge the two companies through a stock transaction to be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Denron shareholders will receive about 1.5 million shares of JPM common stock in exchange for all outstanding Denron common shares, the companies said.
JPM closed down 1/8 at 11-3/8 in Nasdaq trading Monday.
Denron makes cable assemblies and wire harnesses. Its main operations are in San Jose, Calif., with manufacturing support in China and Southeast Asia.
